sourceTitle: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
originalTitle: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: Over a hundred thousand employees across Oracle are using ChatGPT Work and Codex, from talent acquisition to Oracle Applications Lab to the IT organization. In each case, work that used to rely on specialists and take days can now be done by anyone and is complete in minutes. Recruiters skip days of market research, business users describe an outcome instead of hunting for a report, and technical leads build tools that used to take a full team months.
blocks.en: Over a hundred thousand employees across Oracle are using ChatGPT Work and Codex, from talent acquisition to Oracle Applications Lab to the IT organization. In each case, work that used to rely on specialists and take days can now be done by anyone and is complete in minutes. Recruiters skip days of market research, business users describe an outcome instead of hunting for a report, and technical leads build tools that used to take a full team months.
blocks.zh: 从人才招聘团队到 Oracle Applications Lab，再到 IT 部门，Oracle 已有超过十万名员工在使用 ChatGPT 工作和 Codex。在这些团队中，过去需要依靠专业人员、耗时数天的工作，如今任何人都能在几分钟内完成。招聘人员省去了数天的市场调研；业务用户只需描述想要的结果，无须四处查找报表；技术负责人也能独立构建过去需要整个团队花费数月才能完成的工具。

blocks.text: “We’ve built our talent market intelligence tool using ChatGPT Work, and it’s really revolutionized how we do the front end of our recruitment process.”
blocks.en: “We’ve built our talent market intelligence tool using ChatGPT Work, and it’s really revolutionized how we do the front end of our recruitment process.”
blocks.zh: “我们使用 ChatGPT 工作构建了人才市场情报工具，真正革新了招聘流程中前期工作的开展方式。”

blocks.text: The talent acquisition team used ChatGPT Work to build a talent market intelligence tool that takes a job description, researches comparable roles, benchmarks compensation, and assesses the talent pool across relevant locations. The tool arms the recruiter with valuable information that they need going into a conversation with the hiring manager, information that previously took 2–4 days to compile.
blocks.en: The talent acquisition team used ChatGPT Work to build a talent market intelligence tool that takes a job description, researches comparable roles, benchmarks compensation, and assesses the talent pool across relevant locations. The tool arms the recruiter with valuable information that they need going into a conversation with the hiring manager, information that previously took 2–4 days to compile.
blocks.zh: 人才招聘团队使用 ChatGPT 工作构建了一款人才市场情报工具。输入职位描述后，工具就能调研同类岗位、对标薪酬，并评估相关地区的人才储备。这款工具为招聘人员提供了与用人经理沟通前所需的重要信息，而过去整理这些信息需要 2–4 天。

blocks.text: “We’ve gone from zero to a hundred,” says Jan Ackerman, Senior Vice President and Global Head of Talent Acquisition at Oracle. “Now we’re able to sit down and prep for about 15 to 20 minutes using the tool that we’ve built using [ChatGPT] Work.”
blocks.en: “We’ve gone from zero to a hundred,” says Jan Ackerman, Senior Vice President and Global Head of Talent Acquisition at Oracle. “Now we’re able to sit down and prep for about 15 to 20 minutes using the tool that we’ve built using [ChatGPT] Work.”
blocks.zh: “我们的能力实现了从零到一百的飞跃，”Oracle 高级副总裁兼全球人才招聘负责人 Jan Ackerman 表示。“现在，我们坐下来，用这款通过 [ChatGPT] 工作构建的工具，只需大约 15 到 20 分钟就能做好准备。”

blocks.text: Not only is the process faster, but it’s also more consistent. Recruiters used to run the intake process differently from one search to the next, but with the talent market intelligence tool, the process is consistent, so every hiring manager has the same quality of data and insights, no matter which recruiter they worked with.
blocks.en: Not only is the process faster, but it’s also more consistent. Recruiters used to run the intake process differently from one search to the next, but with the talent market intelligence tool, the process is consistent, so every hiring manager has the same quality of data and insights, no matter which recruiter they worked with.
blocks.zh: 流程不仅更快，也更统一。过去，招聘人员在不同招聘任务中梳理用人需求的方式各不相同。有了人才市场情报工具，这一流程得以统一，无论与哪位招聘人员合作，每位用人经理都能获得同等质量的数据和洞察。

blocks.text: Business users get the answers they need faster
blocks.en: Business users get the answers they need faster
blocks.zh: 让业务用户更快获得所需答案

blocks.text: The Oracle Applications Lab team, which helps run many of Oracle’s core business processes, built an ontology of the company’s objects, relationships, and rules, so a plain-language business question can be turned into a reliable SQL query with Codex. A business user describes the outcome they want, and Codex decides which internal systems to call, gathers the information, and returns an analysis, a report, or an application.
blocks.en: The Oracle Applications Lab team, which helps run many of Oracle’s core business processes, built an ontology of the company’s objects, relationships, and rules, so a plain-language business question can be turned into a reliable SQL query with Codex. A business user describes the outcome they want, and Codex decides which internal systems to call, gathers the information, and returns an analysis, a report, or an application.
blocks.zh: Oracle Applications Lab 团队协助运营 Oracle 的多项核心业务流程。他们为公司的各类对象、关系和规则构建了本体模型，让 Codex 能将用日常语言提出的业务问题转化为可靠的 SQL 查询。业务用户描述想要的结果后，Codex 会判断需要调用哪些内部系统，收集信息，并返回分析、报表或应用程序。

blocks.text: That’s a change from how work used to get done. Lam said one user came to him after asking a question that would normally have taken her a couple of hours to answer. She told Lam, “With the new tool, I put in the request and got a response almost immediately.” When she checked the result against the old manual process, the numbers matched exactly.
blocks.en: That’s a change from how work used to get done. Lam said one user came to him after asking a question that would normally have taken her a couple of hours to answer. She told Lam, “With the new tool, I put in the request and got a response almost immediately.” When she checked the result against the old manual process, the numbers matched exactly.
blocks.zh: 这改变了以往的工作方式。Lam 表示，一位用户向工具提出问题后找到了他。通常，她需要花上几个小时才能得出这个问题的答案。她告诉 Lam：“用了新工具，我提交请求后，几乎立刻就得到了回复。”她按以往的人工流程核对结果后，发现数据完全一致。

blocks.text: In production engineering, site reliability engineers use Codex to gather relevant context about an incident and automatically pull up the right playbook. SREs spend more time guiding decisions and less time hunting for information. “A typical simple incident that used to take an hour to resolve can now be handled in minutes,” says Lam.
blocks.en: In production engineering, site reliability engineers use Codex to gather relevant context about an incident and automatically pull up the right playbook. SREs spend more time guiding decisions and less time hunting for information. “A typical simple incident that used to take an hour to resolve can now be handled in minutes,” says Lam.
blocks.zh: 在生产工程领域，站点可靠性工程师使用 Codex 收集故障的相关背景信息，并自动调出适用的处置手册。站点可靠性工程师因此能将更多时间用于指导决策，而不是查找信息。“过去需要一个小时才能解决的普通简单故障，现在几分钟就能处理好，”Lam 表示。

blocks.text: Even as Codex takes on more of the work, Lam is careful to note that none of this runs on autopilot. Someone still has to make sure the underlying system is built right.
blocks.en: Even as Codex takes on more of the work, Lam is careful to note that none of this runs on autopilot. Someone still has to make sure the underlying system is built right.
blocks.zh: 即使 Codex 承担了更多工作，Lam 仍特别强调，这一切并非无需人工干预就能自行运转。仍然需要有人确保底层系统构建得当。

blocks.text: “Business users now describe the outcome they want instead of hunting for a report. That is a major shift. I would even call it a business transformation.”
blocks.en: “Business users now describe the outcome they want instead of hunting for a report. That is a major shift. I would even call it a business transformation.”
blocks.zh: “如今，业务用户只需描述想要的结果，不必再四处查找报表。这是一个重大转变。我甚至会称之为一场业务变革。”

blocks.text: While AI builds the tools, the people are still responsible for the output. A few lessons stand out:
blocks.en: While AI builds the tools, the people are still responsible for the output. A few lessons stand out:
blocks.zh: 虽然工具由 AI 构建，但人仍需对产出负责。以下几点经验尤为重要：

blocks.text: Give the correct guardrails. “You have to still be very responsible about your system design, your architecture, your security, and how you would like Codex to structure the code for you,” says Lam.
blocks.en: Give the correct guardrails. “You have to still be very responsible about your system design, your architecture, your security, and how you would like Codex to structure the code for you,” says Lam.
blocks.zh: 设定恰当的约束。“你仍然必须以高度负责的态度对待系统设计、架构、安全，以及你希望 Codex 如何组织代码，”Lam 表示。

blocks.text: Provide prototypes instead of specs. “Normally, I put [my idea] down on paper, but now I put it down in a prototype,” says Barry Shilmover, Vice President and Technical Advisor to the CIO.
blocks.en: Provide prototypes instead of specs. “Normally, I put [my idea] down on paper, but now I put it down in a prototype,” says Barry Shilmover, Vice President and Technical Advisor to the CIO.
blocks.zh: 用原型代替规格文档。“通常，我会把[我的想法]写在纸上，但现在，我会把它做成原型，”副总裁兼首席信息官技术顾问 Barry Shilmover 表示。

blocks.text: Own the code. “If you don’t work alongside Codex, you’re going to get into a situation of having lots of code that is not going to be maintainable,” says Lam.
blocks.en: Own the code. “If you don’t work alongside Codex, you’re going to get into a situation of having lots of code that is not going to be maintainable,” says Lam.
blocks.zh: 对代码负责。“如果你不与 Codex 并肩协作，最终就会得到大量无法维护的代码，”Lam 表示。

blocks.text: The Oracle team is completely shifting how the company operates with AI. Across recruiting, analytics, and engineering, each line of business described an outcome and let Codex and ChatGPT handle how the work gets done. With thousands of ChatGPT and Codex users already, Oracle employees use AI across countless work tasks. As Shilmover puts it, “I don’t know what the answer is because I don’t know what my next problem to solve will be. I just know that one of the first things I’ll do is I’ll leverage Codex to do that.”
blocks.en: The Oracle team is completely shifting how the company operates with AI. Across recruiting, analytics, and engineering, each line of business described an outcome and let Codex and ChatGPT handle how the work gets done. With thousands of ChatGPT and Codex users already, Oracle employees use AI across countless work tasks. As Shilmover puts it, “I don’t know what the answer is because I don’t know what my next problem to solve will be. I just know that one of the first things I’ll do is I’ll leverage Codex to do that.”
blocks.zh: Oracle 团队正借助 AI 彻底改变公司的运营方式。从招聘、分析到工程，各业务条线只需描述期望的结果，再由 Codex 和 ChatGPT 解决具体如何完成工作的问题。Oracle 已有数以千计的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 用户，员工们将 AI 用于各种各样的工作任务。正如 Shilmover 所说：“我不知道答案是什么，因为我还不知道接下来要解决的问题是什么。我只知道，我首先会做的事情之一，就是借助 Codex 来解决它。”
